result.rationale: The diff literally contains `<%- end if %>` in app/views/embed/best.html.erb closing the `<%- if @topic_view.posts.present? %>` block. ERB emits `end if` as Ruby source; a modifier `if` requires its condition on the same line, so this yields a SyntaxError (or garbage parsing) at render time, breaking the /embed/best view for the success path. The specs in embed_controller_spec.rb stub TopicView/TopicRetriever and never render views, so this ships undetected, exactly as the finding claims.

adjudication.rationale: In app/views/embed/best.html.erb the conditional block is closed with `<%- end if %>` (line shown in the finding). In ERB this emits Ruby code `end if` which is invalid Ruby syntax because `if` requires a condition, so the template should fail to compile/render. The correct terminator is just `<%- end %>` (optionally with `-%>` trimming). The diff also shows controller specs stubbing objects and not enabling `render_views`, so this view syntax error could indeed slip past the added specs.
